researcher_notes: No match in roster: no Ingushetia/Dzheirakh/Erzi row exists. Threshold: (a) sponsor Gazprom (Gazprom builds the line under the 2021-2025 gasification programme; Gazprom Mezhregiongaz CEO Gustov discussed it with Head of Ingushetia at the Caucasus Investment Forum, May 2025 per etokavkaz.ru 2026-01-26); (b) country + region + end point (Erzi/Aerzi children's camp, Dzheirakh district); START point NOT stated in any source (likely at/near GRS Dzheirakh, whose reconstruction was added to the programme Apr 2023 per ingushetia.ru, but no source links them, so StartLocation left blank); (c) concrete step = programme signed by Gazprom (Miller) and Kalimatov Nov 2020, updated Apr 2023 to add GRS Dzheirakh, construction-and-assembly completion planned 2027; no tender/contract/FID found, so (c) rests on a signed programme only - weakest leg, reviewer may prefer monitor; (d) LENGTH 43.2 km (>=25) sourced in official regional press-service statement (etokavkaz.ru 2026-01-26). Earlier figure 52 km (gazetaingush.ru 2021-01-21, 'total 52 km mountainous Dzheirakh district') conflicts; later figure used, 52 km possibly includes other segments or earlier design. Status proposed (no evidence construction started; end-2025 target slipped to 2027). Scope caveat: inter-settlement gas-supply (distribution) line to a camp, not a trunk; PipelineType=distribution. Sources are government press-service origin (not independent) -> medium. FIDStatus left blank (no FID statement). No capacity/diameter/cost found. Route: none; RouteType unavailable, RouteAccuracy no route. Monitor for tender/contractor award and start of construction.
